|notes=The [[Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original 2005)|2005 Gold Edition wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The first slip prevents Force drain initiation at the chosen character’s location and shows Alter immunity. The earlier gallery wording drops that immunity and adds a site qualifier to the highest-power opponent’s character. The June replacement limits deployment to your non-droid character, prevents movement, names a Dark Jedi at a site as the target, and caps your Force loss from those drains at 1. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=1 Players Committee Gold Edition sheet, p. 1, slip 8]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071122135723id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v11/ls/letskeepalittleoptimismhere.gif Earlier Players Committee gallery full card, captured 22 November 2007]. Exact initial publication date unknown. [[:File:VS11O-08-Lets_Keep_A_Little_Optimism_Here.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 2, slip 8]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154617id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive].
